{{Quote|If everything has gone correctly, ''Iron Fist'' is now in the Selaggis system with her hyperdrive inoperable.|[[Gara Petothel]], in a transmission to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>}}
The '''Selaggis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]], which connected it to the [[Bandomeer system/Legends|Bandomeer]] and [[Vahaba system/Legends|Vahaba systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Selaggis system contained the [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Selaggis]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by seven [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], including the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Selaggis VI]]. The planet Selaggis VI was orbited by several [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including [[Selcaron]], and was also circled by a heavy [[Asteroid/Legends|debris]] [[Planetary ring/Legends|ring]] thought to have been another moon at one [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="SC" />
